title: Do you go back to the same place over and over again?
content: I find my dreams to be oddly consistent and linear. Like, I go to schoolworld, and in schoolworld I graduate and then move onto collegeworld. Of course I go to the mall, but this is a relatively new experience in my dreams. I think I've been going to mallworld for just the past year or so. But the mall is always exactly the same. I know where every store is. I especially love the fur shop section in a place that resembles a 1980s Macy's. The schools and the mall are always exactly the same. It's like the architecture of my mind remembers and keeps putting me back in the same places. I know where everything is in my dreams and I revisit locations in nearly every dream. Anyone else experiencing this?
